text: I'd like you to make a voice-over in a calm, reassuring voice. I've been feeling a little overwhelmed lately, which is why this particular message appeals to me. What I have in mind is audio-only, about 10 seconds long, and I want you to read exactly: “Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.” Please don't include any music or other sounds.
